hero.greeting: Hello, my name is Pedro Vitor
hero.bio: I am a Computer Science student with an interest in Data science/engineering. I also like the software engineering part itself, the programming, architecture, and building software part. I also study MLOPs and DEVOPs.
hero.en_notice: Hello, and thanks for the visit. If you do not know portuguese, you can translate to english by clicking in the translate button on the menu.

rec_system.title: Recommender System
rec_system.desc: Unlike the other implementation, this one is more manual. The project consists of an implementation of two methods. One memory-based using KNN and the other is a model-based implementation using SVD by funk.

movie_rec.title: Movie Recommender System
movie_rec.desc: A simple movie recommender system. The user chooses the number of movies they want to evaluate and the system recommends a list of movies they might like.

mini_course.title: Machine Learning Short Course
mini_course.desc: I taught a short introductory course on machine learning. The course covered topics such as data preprocessing, statistical fundamentals, and practical algorithm application.

lin_reg.title: Linear Regression
lin_reg.desc: Iterative development of a linear regression algorithm. The data is processed, ranging from missing value checks to numerical data normalization.

nn_class.title: Classification with Neural Networks
nn_class.desc: A dense neural network system trained to solve a classification problem.

data_analysis.title: Data Analysis
data_analysis.desc: Performed data analysis on an IBGE dataset to discover patterns and details. Applied techniques ranging from machine learning to data mining.

assoc_rules.title: Association Rules
assoc_rules.desc: In this project, I performed a dataset analysis using association rules, such as Support, Confidence, Lift, and Conviction, to identify what factors contributed most to user churn.

clustering.title: Clustering
clustering.desc: Analyzed a dataset containing information about high school students. Data ETL was performed, and using PCA and K-Prototypes, grouping was based on data correlation to highlight areas needing improvement, corrections, and key attention points.

nn_linreg.title: Neural Network for Linear Regression
nn_linreg.desc: Building a simple MLP aimed at learning the representation of a linear regression.

rnn.title: Recurrent Neural Network
rnn.desc: PyTorch implementation of a recurrent neural network for image classification.

encoders.title: Recurrent Neural Network (Encoders)
encoders.desc: Implementation of autoencoders for image anomaly detection. The objective was to tweak architecture variables to achieve better anomaly detection results.

lstm.title: LSTM Neural Network
lstm.desc: LSTM neural network architecture for time series forecasting. In this project, the LSTM was trained to learn Bitcoin price behavior.

f1_vrum.title: F1 vrum-vrum
f1_vrum.desc: A project built to study APIs more deeply by combining the world of F1 with programming. Future plans include data-related features like forecasting and statistical insights.

ecommerce.title: Gaming E-commerce
ecommerce.desc: Developed a gaming e-commerce using the AdonisJS framework based on MVC architecture. The project includes product CRUD (search and pagination), user roles (user and admin levels), a shopping cart, AJAX notifications, Stripe payment integration, and database seeding via the RAWG API.

comp_prog.title: Competitive Programming & Algorithms
comp_prog.desc: Refers to my study and projects focused on algorithms, which led me to prepare for programming marathons. Also includes solutions for several LeetCode problems.

about_me.title: A Little About Me
about_me.subtitle: A Little About My Learning Journey
about_me.desc: During university, I began my studies with C. Later, while studying OOP, I learned core concepts using JAVA, covering polymorphism, inheritance, and encapsulation. I also studied C++ for competitive programming. As shown in the portfolio, I have used TypeScript to build an e-commerce with NodeJS (using agents). Currently, I am focusing more on Python, Golang, and SQL—practicing hands-on skills, modeling, and queries—to pursue my desired career path in Data Science / MLOps. I use Linux on my laptop for programming and learning, including Docker, terminal usage, and more. During college, I also focused my studies on artificial intelligence, covering subjects such as AI, machine learning, data mining, neural networks, natural language processing, and recommendation systems. Now, I am exploring a different area: software engineering and architecture.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.desc: I am available for new opportunities and collaborations.
